name: Com lang
summary: Cơm làng, village rice, is a weekend-market food that visitors eat with smoked meat and traditional cakes. It is a different dish from the bamboo-tube cơm lam.
howToEat: Eat it at the market with smoked meat and traditional cakes.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
seoDescription: Cơm làng, village rice, eaten with smoked meat and cakes at the Mang Den weekend market.
